Scope

-1 Lays down the proforma for the preparation of purchase specification for belt drop hammers. It gives essential information about the belt drop hammers and their accessories which will enable 18 users to assess their usefulness and applicability.

3. Design
3.1 Hammer - The component and the duty requirements.

design

of

hammer

is to take care of the general

working

conditions

Components which are to be designed on the basis of strength shall be designed with minimum safety factor of 6. The component designed on the basis of life shall be designed for minimum life of 40 000 hours. 3.2 Anvil - The anvil block bottom shall be fully machined to give good seating on the foundation and to avoid load concentration. Top shall be machined for seating the standards. Suitable provision shall be made for fixing die holder. Spigot guide shall be provided in the anvil block for taking spigot of the standard. 3.3 Standards - Standards addition to the load of lifter stability. are to be designed for taking the shock load due to fall of the tup in mechanism. Foot of the standard shall be of larger area to give greater between anvil block and standard as well as between

Resilient joint material shall be provided standard and lifter structure to absorb shock.

The

3.4 Lifter Structure - Lifter structure shall be of fabricated construction either welded or riveted. structure shall be machined at the bottom to have good seat on the standard. All pads for machinery seating on the top shall be fabricated before the stress relieving and integrally machined. (Welding of machined pad is not recommended.)

3.5 Guides - The guides shall be guiding minimum 75 percent of the tup, even in extreme position. Guides shalt be reversible type in order to prolong its life. guides shall be machined on either sides 3.6 TOP - Suitable minimum 1 : 2 times the distance between the opposite sides. and total length of guide shall be The belt material

3.7 Lifting Belt -The belt shall be designed for minimum factor of safety of 6. shall be capable of withstanding the heat encountered in the normal operation.

with

3.8 Gear-Train - The gear shall be fully machined to the accuracy for medium quality in accordance IS : 4059-1967 `Accuracy requirements for medium quality medium speed gears'. High speed gears and pinions, if used, shall be statically balanced. 3.9 Drive - First stage transmission shall be through belt drive to avoid transmission of shock to motor from lifter mechanism. Belts shall be provided with liberal duty factor to take care of shock load and peak load factor. Suitable flywheel shall be provided effect on the motor within the safe limit. in the system to absorb the peak load and keep the peak The flywheel shall be balanced. load

3.10 Fasteners - The fasteners used shall be of suitable class conforming to IS : 1367 ( Part 3 )-1979 properties and test methods `Technical supply conditions for threaded fasteners : Part 3 Mechanical for bolts, screws and studs with full loadability' and shall be of semi-precision grade. Fasteners of other suitable quality can also be used.

3.11 Lubrication - All bearings and sliding surfaces shall be provided with positive lubrication arrangement. Automatic lubrication is essential if bush bearings are used. Other bearings shall be either provided with automatic or individual lubrication points suitably positioned. Continuous running gears shall be provided with oil bath type lubrication. 3.12 Slip - The full load slip of the motor shall not be more than 5 percent. This slip can be achieved by permanently connected resistance in the rotor circuit in case of slip ring motor. 3.12.1
Torque -

Minimum

pull-out

torque shall be 25 percent of full load torque. in the selection of No derating due

3.12.2 Ambient temperature - Derating for ambient temperature is applicable the motor if this is called for as per the service condition and stated in the enquiry. to temperature is required under normal condition. 3.12.3
Motor speed -

Motor speed higher than 1 500 rev/mm shall not be used. 5

e) The words `Made in India'. 5. Safety Operation and Operator Protection

5.1 Platform and Hand RailSuitable platform shall be provided at the level of lifter mechanism for maintenance. Size of the platform shall be sufficient for two persons to stand. Minimum width shall be 600 mm. It shall be capable of taking a moving load of 200 kg. A permanent ladder shall be provided from ground level to the platform.

Platform shall be provided with suitable hand rail. There shall be minimum two rails, the top rail at the height of 1 000 to 1 100 mm from the platform floor and the other one in between the floor and the top rail. The rails shall be of 20 mm N : B tubes /Win, heavy class conforming to IS : 11611979 `Steel tubes for structural purposes ( third revision)`. 5.2 Control - Control cord shall be of hand pulling pull cord system or of servo-control system. It shall be possible to convert Length of stroke shall be adjustable in case of servo-control system. the control from servo-control to manual pull cord system without difficulty. Pull on the cord required shall not be more than 2 kg. Pull cord shall be provided with positive safety limit to avoid over-travel of tup and hitting the lifter structure. In addition to this, suitable buffers shall be provided below lifter structure to absorb impact in the event of accidental over travel of tup. 5.3 Electrical ControlsAll control handles, pedals, push buttons shall be placed in convenient position to allow the operator ample room for operation and permit an unrestricted space for operation. Unless otherwise specified by the purchaser and agreed to by the manufacturer, direct-on-line ac starter conforming to IS : 8544 ( Part 1 )-I977 ' Motor starter for voltage not exceeding 1 000 V : Part 1 Direct-on-line ac starter' shall be used for motors up to IO hp. Above 10 hp star-delta starters' or any other suitable type of starters shall be used to avoid excessive starting current. 5.4 Electrical
Protection

5.4.1 Overload protection - Overload protection for motors against overloading shall be provided for each motor by means of thermal overload relay or magnetic overload relay operating the line contactor. Three phase motors shall be protected by overload tripping devices on each phase.

5.4.2 Short-circuit protection - This can be in the form of HRC fuses incorporated in the isolating switches. The purchaser shall also provide suitable circuit breaker with instant short-circuit release. 5.4.3 No Volt Protection - No volt protection shall be provided for the equipment. It shall be so designed that the machine does not start again by itself when the supply is restored following an interruption in supply. The following protections are considered optional: a) Single-phasing b) Under voltage protection, protection. and accelerating specitications. a motor to normal speed, and

5.4.4 Starter - Motor starter shall be suitable for starting having no `running' position other than `full on' position. All starters shall comply with relevant Indian Standard 6

5.8 Gear Tram - Gear train shall be properly protected from exposure to atmosphere. This can be done by suitable guards fabricated out of heavy gauge sheet steel. - 1985

NOTE

quoting

preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the document `Form and enquiry, and/or during drop forge plant' issued by Electra Forge Association Standard, England.

This standard has been prepared to enable a prospective buyer to collect data from various manufacturers/suppliers for purposes of comparison before purchasing a belt drop hammer and also to give guidance for testing and commissioning of the same. The proforma contained in the standard is meant to be sent out with an enquiry by the purchaser so that the manufacturers/suppliers can fill in the data and send it back to the purchaser to make comparison easier for the purchaser. Reference is made to the following IS : 5-1978 Indian Standards in this standard:

Colours for ready mixed paints and enamels ( third revision) Steel tubes for structural of three-phase purposes (third
revision )
